turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hello, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Well, what brings me in is that my sleep has just become... completely unmoored. 

At first, I was waking up after only two or three hours, drafting plans and feeling completely ready to go. But now... now I just lie awake way before dawn. My stomach gets all tight, and I have absolutely no sense of rest.

turns.doctor_question: During those days when you had all that energy, did your actions or behavior cause any significant problems at work, with your family, or in your social life?

Yes, it really did. Um... my wife has actually had to step in and take over all of our finances. She's also been staying right by my side at home just to make sure I'm safe, because things just got so out of hand. 

And as for my social life and other obligations... well, I've just stopped showing up reliably for things. I volunteer at the museum and I'm on the arts council, but I haven't been going to those at all. I've pretty much stopped seeing my friends, too. It's just... it's disrupted quite a bit.
